speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms and when it first started? Also, has the numbness and tingling spread to any other parts of your body?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of working in a rice paddy, I suspect cutaneous larva migrans or a similar parasitic infection. REQUEST TEST: Skin Scraping for Microscopic Examination

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the test results. Since the skin scraping was normal, I need to rule out other causes. Do you have any other symptoms such as muscle weakness, weight loss, or night sweats? Have you noticed any changes in your nails or hair?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of hypopigmented macules, eyebrow thinning, and Madarosis (loss of eyelashes) strongly suggests Hansen's disease. REQUEST TEST: Slit-skin Smear for Acid-Fast Bacilli

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: RESULTS: Skin_Biopsy: Chronic inflammatory cells with features suggestive of leprosy. Nerve_Conduction_Studies: Reduced sensory nerve action potentials in the ulnar nerves. Serology: Anti-PGL-1_antibodies: Positive

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy, nerve conduction studies, and positive serology confirm the diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Hansen's disease (Leprosy)
